newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-FLO FREE TO JOIN CHELSEA FOR SEASON START.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FLO FREE TO JOIN CHELSEA FOR SEASON START.

text.p: Norwegian international striker Tore Andre Flo has been cleared to join English premier league side Chelsea for the start of the new season, the Norwegian news agency NTB reported on Tuesday.
The London club have reached a financial deal to buy the striker out of his present contract which is due to run until the end of October.
Flo's last match for Brann Bergen will be against Stromsgodset in the Norwegian league on Sunday. The English league season kicks off at the start of next month.
